# Ludo Dethroned 5 Way & 4 Way Two Dice

> Ludo Dethroned 5 Way & 4 Way Two Dice is a five-player, 3D Ludo-style strategy game played with two dice, where the first player to get all four tokens onto their coloured home path wins. The game is played on a 3D board with 3D tokens and dice.

- Homepage: https://ludodethroned.com/
- Play 4 Way Arena: https://ludodethroned.com/play-4-way
- Play 5 Way Arena: https://ludodethroned.com/play-5-way

## Summary of Confirmed Rules & Facts
- Players and tokens: Five players, four tokens each. Player colours: red, green, yellow, blue and orange.
- Dice: Two dice used on every turn. Use both on one token, or one on each of two tokens. If you have no legal move, the turn passes. Tokens and turns move clockwise.
- Sixes: A single 6 brings a token out of base. Every 6 gives an extra turn, with no limit on how many in a row.
- Capturing: Landing on a lone opponent token on the open track sends it to base and gives you a reroll. Compulsory under Rule 7.
- Safe from capture: Star squares, coloured home paths and base. A pair is safe from a single token.
- Pairs: Two tokens of the same colour on the same square. Captured only when two opposing tokens land together, one with each die. Capturing a pair gives one reroll. A pair can be split freely.
- Missed Capture Penalty: If you could capture and did not, the token that could have captured goes back to base.
- Centre home: Reaching it needs an exact roll and gives an extra turn, but it is not needed to win.
- Lucky 7: With no token on the open track, a total of 7 counts as 6+6 and gives an extra turn. Two tokens can come out of base.
- Lucky Wish: Two numbers chosen before the match, used once on any turn, 6 and 6 not allowed. A wish totalling 7 can trigger Lucky 7.
- Turn timer: Optional, set by the room host (60, 90, 120 seconds or off). When it runs out, the turn passes.
- End of the match: The match ends as soon as a player wins. The other players are ranked by progress percentage.
